entries.name: 12th Lamashan, 4713
entries.log: March from Drezen - investigating possible cultist site in the marchlands

entries.name: 13th Lamashan, 4713
entries.log: Second day marching toward the Fallen Fane along the Ahari Riverbed. A hail of teeth forced the party to shelter under a bridge. When the weather broke, they briefly explored the abandoned town by the river, but quickly pressed on.

entries.name: 14th Lamashan, 4713
entries.log: Third day of the march toward the Fallen Fane. The party reached the head of the Ahari river but as they emerged from the riverbed, encountered several swarms of ticks. Retreated and struck out south.

entries.name: 15th Lamashan, 4713
entries.log: Fourth day in search of the Fallen Fane. The party suffered from a cold night, unprepared for the harsh conditions of the Worldwound. Cornelia assumed the shape of a vulture to scout as they searched for the cultist stronghold. A patrol was spotted, and the party tracked their backtrail near the cliffs before camping for the night in a cave.

entries.name: 16th Lamashan, 4713
entries.log: The party found a well-worn and ancient trail leading down the cliffs and a wide gave housing a temple of Baphomet, serving as a cultist waystation. Varic strongly believes this to be a sacred site to Sarenrae which has been defiled, which drives him into a rage.

entries.name: 17th Lamashan, 4713
entries.log: Spent the night in the Fallen Fane

entries.name: 18th Lamashan, 4713
entries.log: On the way back to Drezen from the fallen fane. Ashstorms slow progress

entries.name: 19th Lamashan, 4713
